name: @steuererklaerung/invoice-pdf
author: Pascal Garber
description: Invoice PDF renderer for the self invoicing provider. Runtime-agnostic layout/model + a GJS (cairo/Pango) renderer; on Node the renderer is a stub (PDF rendering needs the GJS runtime). DIN 5008 layout, per-VAT-rate totals, SEPA GiroCode. Pure TypeScript.
